  • Method Details

    • placeholder

      String placeholder()
      Returns the placeholder string associated with the render component.
      Returns:
      the placeholder string

    • appliesTo

      default boolean appliesTo(@NotNull @NotNull String line)
      Determines if the given line contains the placeholder string associated with the render component.
      Parameters:
      line - the line to check against the placeholder, must not be null
      Returns:
      true if the line contains the placeholder, false otherwise

    • fullLine

      boolean fullLine()
      Determines if this render component is a full line replacement. If it is a full line replacement, no other renderers will be run on the same line, and the rendering process will skip to the next line.
      Returns:
      true if this is a full line replacement, false otherwise.

    • supportsSnapshot

      boolean supportsSnapshot()
      Determines if this render component supports snapshot rendering.
      Returns:
      true if snapshot rendering is supported, false otherwise.

    • renderSnapshot

      net.kyori.adventure.text.Component renderSnapshot(@NotNull @NotNull SignRenderSnapshot snapshot, ProxiedLocale locale)
      Renders the snapshot of the current state of the SignRenderSnapshot. This method is responsible for rendering a visual representation of the shop based on the details provided in the snapshot.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the SignRenderSnapshot containing all the data required to render a representation of the shop, must not be null
      locale - the locale to be used for rendering the components
      Returns:
      a Component representing the rendered snapshot output

    • render

      net.kyori.adventure.text.Component render(@NotNull @NotNull Shop shop, @NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item, ProxiedLocale locale)
      Renders a component based on the provided shop and item data.
      Parameters:
      shop - the shop instance containing all relevant data needed for rendering, must not be null
      item - the item stack representing the item associated with the shop, must not be null
      locale - the locale to be used for rendering the components, defining language and formatting settings
      Returns:
      a Component representing the rendered output based on the provided shop and item data
